messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — GC team wants to ship a tiered promo next week. We need a carveout rule so legacy customers keep their existing credits for 6 months. Question: how should this appear on invoices and in the usage reconciliation?
Tom Nguyen: +1. Do we have the promo sheet yet? link? Also need to flag reserved capacity customers (committed discounts) — they shouldn't get double credits.
Aisha Patel: Spreadsheet here: https://docs.redwood/finance/tiered-promo-v3 (private). Main ask: two cohorts — 'legacy' (signup < 2025-01-01) and 'new'. Legacy -> preserve monthly promo credits as a line item: "Legacy Promo Credit (preserved)".
Priya Rao: For reconciliation I'd prefer credits to be a separate ledger entry with a reference id so accounting can match against invoices. Example CSV column set: 
```
customer_id,invoice_id,credit_code,amount,reason
12345,inv-2025-03-01,LEGACY-PRESERVE, -250,signup_before_2025-01-01
```
Liam Ortiz: Vendor question — some customers have vendor pass-through fees on top of Redwood bill. If we preserve credits, do we reduce pass-through portion too? That could change vendor invoices. Need vendor ops input.
billing-bot: automated-recon: preliminary diff for cohort "legacy" vs baseline: disputed_invoices=3, net_credit_sum= -$4,200. See /recon/178 for details.
Tom Nguyen: Edgecase: customers on Reserved with committed discount + legacy credits. We should not allow credits to exceed billable usage for the month (no negative net invoices). Also need proration rules if promo starts mid-cycle.
Aisha Patel: Agreed. Proposed rule set: 1) apply preserved credit as distinct line item; 2) clamp credit so invoice_total >= 0; 3) if reserved discount exists, credit applies after discount; 4) no vendor-fee reduction unless vendor ops signs off.
Priya Rao: I'll draft a small runbook for billing ops and an SQL to tag eligible accounts. SQL snippet: `UPDATE customers SET promo_cohort='legacy' WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01' AND account_status='active';`
Liam Ortiz: I'll ping vendor-ops for the pass-through impact. If vendor asks for adjustment we'll need a one-time offset accounting entry.
FinOps Signoff: requesting formal approval matrix — who okays the carveout? I need names + timeline. Also confirm rollback plan if disputes spike > 0.5% of invoices.
Aisha Patel: Approvers: Priya (Billing), Tom (Revenue Ops), Liam (Vendor Ops). Timeline: canary to 5% of accounts on 2026-04-06, full rollout 2026-04-13 if canary stable. Rollback: revert price-sheet v3 and issue reversal credits with `reason=promo-revocation`.
Tom Nguyen: Metrics to watch during canary: disputed_invoices_count, net_revenue_delta, refund_rate, vendor_adjustments. I'll add alerts: `disputes > 5` or `refund_rate > 0.5%` to the channel.
Priya Rao: I'll prepare the reconciliation playbook + example commands: `./reconcile --cohort legacy --since 2026-04-06` and a dashboard for invoice disputes.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team. @Liam please confirm vendor ops by EOD. @FinOps Signoff please post formal sign-off once you have the matrix. :thumbsup:
